source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-34

procedures.title: Panel replacement
steps: Line up the new panel and clamp it so a closed V butt joint forms at the junction.
If clamping is impossible, hold alignment with 3/16 inch bolts and large washers on both the inner and outer sides, or with straps and sheet metal screws.
Wet the woven glass cloth backup plies in the mix by dipping or brushing.
notes: Figure 54 on this page shows rear body construction.
